YCMOU is a statutory state open university (established 1989, NAAC 'A' Grade in 2022) serving Maharashtra through Open and Distance Learning, with programmes spanning UG, PG, diploma and certificate levels and no single university-wide fee, instead using University Share Fee (USF) and Learner Support Centre Fee (LSCF) components. Its distance MBA (₹39,036 total, per detailed source) and MCA are positioned as affordable alternatives to conventional full-time programmes but require MBA-CET qualification and Mathematics/Statistics background respectively.
